key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks (Headlines 31, 70)
AUD smashed on growth scare, compounding pressure on commodity exporters and importers (Headline 43)
Iron ore 'bloodletting' begins, signalling a structural demand shift from China (Headline 37)
Oil prices explode as OPEC+ suppression fails; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c (Headlines 45, 29)
ANZ axes 3,500 jobs in major restructuring; banking sector under structural pressure (Headline 2)
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path (Headline 56)
Australia softens local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears (Headline 71)
Housing prices crash at high end while affordable segment remains resilient; first-home buyers surge (Headlines 47, 82)
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals capital stress in junior sector (Headline 32)
Chinese inflation soars, adding global macro uncertainty (Headline 79)

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore bloodletting underway; oil surge benefits energy names but weighs on industrial metals. Junior miners scrambling for capital via cap raises. Gold under pressure ('Gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression from falling iron ore. Oil beneficiaries (WDS.AX, SSO.AX) may outperform. Junior miners (SUN.AX, MNR.AX, CRB.AX) face dilution risk. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) underperforming.

sectors.trend: Negative. ANZ restructuring 3,500 roles signals industry-wide cost pressure. Banks tumbling alongside miners on rate fears and rising bond yields. NIM compression risk from rental inflation focus.
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX restructuring may support near-term EPS but signals weak loan growth. CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face similar margin pressure. Rising yields support bond portfolios but hurt equity valuations.

sectors.trend: Positive for producers. Oil price explosion and 30c fuel price rise benefit upstream. Australia softening gas supply rules supports Santos and gas exporters. Global clean investment falls 17% on China pullback.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from oil surge and relaxed gas rules. Downstream (BPL.AX, AGL.AX) face input cost pressure. Renewables (LRN.AX, IGN.AX) hit by clean investment decline.

sectors.trend: Mixed-negative. Woolworths breaches own 'Price Freeze' on staples, eroding trust. Women's clothing chain closes 177 stores. Business confidence deteriorating. Fuel price rise squeezes household budgets.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs and consumer caution. Retailers under structural pressure. Defensive staples may see rotation but pricing power questioned.

sectors.trend: Negative. High-end property sees steepest falls; rental inflation keeps RBA on alert. Bathla in distress signals developer stress. First-home buyer surge supports affordable segment.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face yield compression if RBA holds rates. Developer names (Bathla) in distress. Affordable housing plays may benefit from policy support. NZ housing correction in progress.

sectors.trend: Neutral-positive. Proton therapy project stalled but Critical Resources battery tech passes month-long test. HIVE/BUZZ HPC scales AI cloud. Wipro AI frees 20,000-worker capacity globally.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Battery tech (CRB.AX) and AI cloud (HIVE.AX) offer growth exposure. Small-cap tech (NEU.AX, ION.AX) showing relative strength.

key_themes: Oil price surge and fuel cost inflation driving input-cost pressure across sectors
Iron ore demand deterioration from China; structural shift underway
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare; rate path uncertain
AUD weakness amplifies import costs and pressures commodity exporters
Mining sector capital stress: cap-raise wave and junior dilution risk
Housing bifurcation: high-end crash vs affordable resilience
Superannuation policy debate intensifying with One Nation proposals
Geopolitical risk: Germany election, UK sanctions, India summit, China Arctic routing
Business confidence deteriorating; consumer spending under pressure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike driving inflation and rate expectations higher
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour downstream and consumer staples with pricing power; monitor OPEC+ response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse from China; structural revenue hit to major miners
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate to gold or energy; monitor Chinese PMI and steel data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy dilemma: rental inflation vs growth scare may force premature hike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Short-duration bonds; avoid rate-sensitive REITs and property developers; watch RBA statement language

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness amplifying import costs and corporate FX losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid heavy importers; monitor AUD/USD and commodity-linked pairs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining junior cap-raise wave signalling sector-wide capital stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid dilutive small-caps; favour cash-flow-positive majors; monitor Canaccord-led raises for sector sentiment

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation: Germany election, UK sanctions, India-Russia-Iran summit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain gold allocation; diversify geographically; monitor commodity supply-chain disruptions

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers benefiting from oil surge and relaxed gas rules
opportunities.rationale: Oil price explosion and Australia softening gas supply rules create tailwind for upstream; 30c fuel rise supports revenue

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into defensive healthcare and quality consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX and defensive staples offer resilience amid $90bn ASX sell-off and business confidence decline

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to battery tech and AI cloud on relative strength
opportunities.rationale: Critical Resources passes month-long test; HIVE/BUZZ HPC scaling; small-cap tech showing runners

opportunities.recommendation: Position for affordable housing recovery via policy-driven demand
opportunities.rationale: First-home buyer surge and migrant-driven construction demand support affordable housing plays

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG weightings
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting signals structural demand shift; Chinese inflation and Arctic routing add uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration bonds; avoid long-duration REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern may force hold or hike; AUD weakness adds FX risk to bond portfolios

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid dilutive junior mining cap raises; stay cash on small-caps
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led cap-raise wave signals sector stress; dilution risk elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 5-8% gold allocation as geopolitical hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Germany election, UK sanctions, India summit, and China Arctic routing elevate tail risk

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation fears and iron ore weakness persist. RBA rhetoric on rental inflation may trigger further rate-hike pricing. AUD weakness adds volatility. Expect 3-5% further downside on ^AXJO before stabilisation.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing bifurcation supports affordable segment; energy transition and battery tech offer structural growth. Banking restructuring (ANZ model) may support EPS recovery by 2027. Iron ore oversupply risk is the key overhang for materials.
